paper.title: Particle Swarm Optimization of a Wind Farm Layout with Active Control of Turbine Yaws

public_source_search.result: complete arXiv manuscript source found; no paper-linked optimizer, wake evaluator, case-data, or result-replay source located
public_source_search.publisher_data_statement: No data was used for the research described in the article.

cited_method_predecessor.title: Adaptive Granularity Learning Distributed Particle Swarm Optimization for Large-Scale Optimization
cited_method_predecessor.source_search_result: no algorithm source located; public paper provides Eqs. 3-9 and Algorithm 1

used_controls.inertia: independent uniform random value per coordinate
used_controls.updated_particles: only the worst particle in each subpopulation

paper_equations.wake: Eqs. 1-6, three-dimensional yawed Gaussian wake and local-inlet linear velocity-deficit superposition
paper_equations.atmosphere_and_aep: Eqs. 11-13, power-law shear, rotor average, power curve, and probability-weighted AEP
paper_equations.joint_problem: Eqs. 14-17, x-y position plus one yaw per turbine and wind, reciprocal-AEP minimization, square boundary, and pair spacing greater than D
paper_equations.target_update: paper Eq. 10 plus cited AGLDPSO Eqs. 3-9 and Algorithm 1

paper_native_cases.wind: eight equiprobable directions at Uref=8 m/s
eight equiprobable directions at Uref=6 m/s
eight equiprobable directions at Uref=8 m/s
eight equiprobable directions at Uref=8 m/s
eight equiprobable directions at Uref=8 m/s
west 11 m/s at 20 percent; northwest and southwest 9 m/s at 15 percent each; five remaining directions 8 m/s at 10 percent each

missing_information: author in-house source, case arrays, random states, and optimizer traces
wind-paper population, termination, and repeat count
V80 and V112 machine-readable power and thrust curves
V112 hub height and rotor-to-hub-center distance
heterogeneous position-yaw scaling used by LSH

wake_and_turbines.V80: D=80 m, hub=70 m, rated power=2 MW
wake_and_turbines.V112: D=112 m, hub=84 m, rated power=3 MW
wake_and_turbines.curves: deterministic integer-speed digitization of paper Fig. 5 with linear interpolation and 4/25 m/s cut-in/cut-out
wake_and_turbines.rotor_to_hub_center_distance: zero because the missing value is not recoverable
wake_and_turbines.yaw_power_factor: cos(gamma), following the paper statement that upstream power loss is proportional to cos(gamma)

optimizer_and_constraints.constraint_handler: deterministic bound clamp and iterative pair-spacing repair
optimizer_and_constraints.reason: retain every cited AGLDPSO control that is portable to the wind problem; use an explicit bounded wind-paper completion where the paper provides no termination or repeats

mathematical_reformulations: wind trigonometry and turbine tables precomputed
one stable upstream sweep per wind state
outer candidate parallelism avoids nested oversubscription
counter-keyed random events and fixed reductions preserve one/all-core scientific identity
hpc.formal_resource_rule: one process owns all twenty Waffle cores; six cases and 25 seeds run sequentially

paper_scale_anchor.interpretation: scale consistency only; it is not an author-result replay claim

claim_boundary: Academic flexible declared reconstruction of the target AGLDPSO and all six paper problems; not author-code, private-data, random-bitstream, or numerical-result replay.
